scope: Code and first-principles comparison. No supplier validation, new CFD or new Lean build.

imported_source.mass_basis: Source DOCX nominal conversion; exact reference air state requires supplier confirmation.
imported_source.heat_basis: UA reproduces a 4 K cold-path rise at four motors and 30 C ambient. Motor heat pickup zero is a nominal hypothesis, not a vendor thermal guarantee.
imported_source.load: Sustained loaded catalogue point. Extracted shaft heat stays outside cold stream and target.

agreement.note: Near-1C agreement shares the same loaded-motor assumptions; it is not independent validation.

receiver.limitation: 6.3 bar gives zero regulator headroom. 6.8 bar reserves an assumed 0.5 bar; neither is a transient hardware prediction.

cold_hose_backpressure.issue: Positive exhaust loss is clipped at atmospheric pressure. Motor exhaust pressure is not coupled back to the motor model.

wind_metric.issue: The wind expression counts total cooled mixture capacity as added warm-air capacity. Even the corrected bound is not a wind-tolerance prediction.

vortex_tank_mass_balance.issue: Storage depletion uses cold outlet flow instead of total tank draw, omitting hot vortex exhaust.

warnings: Expander wants 78.0 g/s but the compressor supplies 40.1 g/s. Motors run at 51 % load. Try burst mode with a receiver, or a bigger compressor.

reduced_flow_and_heat_gain.limitation: Motor power/flow scaling is assumed. The fixed-UA result only isolates the hose assumption; it is not a new source prediction.

system_energy.issue: Allocated air-energy COP is not measured complete-plant COP. Part-load fuel/electricity, treatment and auxiliary consumption are not resolved.

schematic_figures.ideal_cycle: Hypothetical compressor/expander work recovery. Its 80% expander efficiency is not the four-motor catalogue point.

shared_limits: No complete pressure-flow network in either the calculator or prescribed-inlet outdoor CFD.
No reported 3D cooled-air mass/volume/persistence from the current CFD campaign.
Source exhaust temperature, load, treatment, heat pickup and transients remain conditional.

existing_test_scope: The six supplied tests lock prior preset outputs and a JT approximation. They do not check these pressure, mixing and storage constraints.
